title: Context-aware vision-language model agent enriched with domain-specific ontology for construction site safety monitoring
task: 本体增强的施工现场实时安全合规监测
inputData: 施工现场图像/实时视频 + 安全规则与本体层级提示 + 视觉问答指令
contribution: 提出面向施工安全的领域化VLM智能助理，以GPT-4V与GroundingDINO辅助构造图文数据，采用两阶段课程学习和LoRA微调CogAgent/CogVLM，并将施工安全本体嵌入层次化提示，实现真实工地的实时高处作业合规检查。
abstract: A context-aware vision-language virtual assistant is developed for construction safety monitoring. The framework combines semi-automatic multimodal data labeling, two-stage curriculum fine-tuning, and ontology-driven hierarchical prompting. It is deployed on a real construction site for real-time video safety analytics and interactive visual question answering.
methodology: GPT-4V and GroundingDINO support a semi-automatic image–text annotation pipeline. CogAgent, built on CogVLM 17B, is adapted with LoRA. The final dataset contains 1,500 augmented construction-site images; 900 are used for training/validation (600 crowdsourced internet images and 300 target-site images) and 600 target-site images are reserved for testing. A two-stage curriculum first develops construction-context understanding and then site-specific task capability. At inference, a construction-safety ontology is converted into hierarchical, domain-role and chain-of-thought style prompts for VQA-based compliance analysis. The system is deployed at the Shek Wu Hui Sewage Treatment Works site.
results: The baseline VLM achieves sensitivity/specificity of 76.3%/74.3%. Ontology-driven prompting alone reaches 86.5%/85.5%, curriculum learning alone 84.7%/91.7%, and their integration reaches 90.3% sensitivity and 92.5% specificity. The real-site deployment therefore demonstrates over-90% performance for work-at-height safety compliance monitoring.
taskEn: Ontology-enhanced real-time construction-site safety compliance monitoring
inputDataEn: Construction-site images/live video plus safety-rule/ontology prompts and visual-question instructions
operationEvidence: The fine-tuned VLM analyzes site imagery against ontology-grounded work-at-height rules and outputs evaluated compliance/violation judgments in a real-time monitoring system.
